comments.body:
The RC car in the picture is a work in progress. It's about 30% complete. Most competitors I see in this field make video game assets, not real parts. Also has blender plugin for very good render: https://i.imgur.com/sQ4hSrd.png

Been working on the system on and off for 3+ years. Started getting okay results early 2026: https://i.imgur.com/8iCN5LJ.png

PS looking for a sales person.
